dump_flops_info: dump flops information for a PyTorch model to an output directory using mobile_cv and fvcore counters
add_flop_printing_hook: add a forward pre-hook to a model that prints and saves flops on the first call
default_flop_counter: register a default flop counter profiler that attaches flop printing to a model via config
add_print_flops_callback: add a callback to log model flops and parameter count after the first inference
attach_profilers: attach all configured profilers from a config object to a model
